name: MII_PR_Mikrobio_Probe
title: MII PR Microbiology Specimen
description: Specimen describes the material examined microbiologically. The profile derives from the biospecimen base profile of the MII Biobank module and adds the expectations of microbiological diagnostics.
purpose: This profile gives Observation.specimen of the microbiological investigation profiles a target profile and names the information that matters for microbiology.

element.short: Specimen type. To be stated even when the material is already pre-coordinated in the LOINC code used — only then is the specimen type available in a structured form, independently of the investigation code.

Reference to the material from which this specimen was obtained — for instance an isolate from a primary specimen. Carries the chain from the primary specimen to the isolate to which susceptibility testing and resistance mechanisms refer.
Collection time. If it is unknown, Specimen.receivedTime can be documented instead; the parent, however, requires collected[x] mandatorily.

element.comment: Up to 2027.0.0-ballot.rc2 the parent mandatorily required the extension 'temperaturbedingungen' here, an obligation stemming from biospecimen storage with no relevance to microbiological processing. Since 2027.0.0-ballot it is 0..1 and limited to the storage-process slice. The staining technique is nevertheless stated not here but in Observation.extension[faerbung], as long as it remains open whether a Specimen resource is created at all.
